title: Rav Chinena bar Yehudah

paragraphs: In [Sanhedrin 77b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.77b.14) he speaks in Rav’s name. Dikdukei Soferim cites from a manuscript the reading Rav Chinena bar Shelamya, who Hyman says was in fact Rav’s student.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara gives Rav Chinena bar Yehudah speaking in Rav’s name. [Heilprin’s Chinena bar Yehudah entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1448&lang=en) is a cross-reference to his Rav Chana material. Hyman reports a manuscript reading of Chinena bar Shelamya from Dikdukei Soferim and identifies Shelamya’s son as Rav’s student.
